summary: Chapters 17 (Justice), 18 (Labor), 19 (Transportation), 20 (Veterans Affairs), 21 (Commerce) and 22 (Treasury) were read in full and matched against the existing records. 51 further recommendations were researched, independently reviewed and scored blind for significance: 7 in chapter 17, 12 in chapter 18, 8 in chapter 19, 6 in chapter 20, 8 in chapter 21 and 10 in chapter 22. By status: 3 blocked, 2 completed, 2 diverged, 5 implemented, 19 in progress, 11 not started, 9 proposed. No candidate was dropped in review as a duplicate. Review changed the stage of 7 records (c17-15, c19-11, c19-12, c20-12, c21-10, c22-12, c22-13) and lowered the progress of 6 others, in most cases to a more cautious one, and corrected the wording of 12. The counted set is now 424 recommendations. Candidates left behind the 12-per-chapter cap or set aside as weakly checkable are listed in the work queue for the second pass. The chapter summaries for chapters 17 to 22 were rewritten to cover all of their records.
title: Fuller reading of chapters 17 to 22: 51 recommendations added
